content.thinking: I'm reading a Hebrew savings-fund page: the employer and employee contribution caps are up to 7.5% and 2.5% of salary, capped at 15,712 ₪, which means part of the user's 30,000 ₪ salary wouldn't count. A menu bar is covering part of the page, and I'm skipping one unclear figure.

The narration is in Hebrew, but it is a user reading a pension-fund statement and the text is not addressed to me; it's Claude's own reading-aloud. Rewriting in Hebrew: I'm reviewing the savings statement and found a 30,000 monthly-salary input, a 7% return figure that looks like a site projection, and a large 64,761 tax deduction; I'll explain the 47% withholding next.

בדקתי את הטקסט: הקרן מפוקחת על ידי רשות שוק ההון, ומתי הכסף פנוי נקבע לפי ששה שנים, בניגוד לחמש שהופיעה בתמונה למעלה. דמי הניהול עד 2% בשנה, ואין דמי יציאה; הקו האפור הקטן עם תקרות החוק אינו קריא, ולכן אדלג עליו.

content.text:
The brown box with the "!": "משיכה לפני הזמן אפשרית, אבל יקרה". So that 64,761 is only if I take the money before six years. The chart is set to 5, so the first thing I saw was the worst case.
"סיכונים ומה לא מוגן": "המדינה לא ערבה לשווי הקרן, והוא עולה ויורד עם ההשקעות". So it goes up and down, like that fund of mine. That's what I was afraid of.
"מונחים" is a long table. I'm tired; this is the fourth screen and my eyes hurt from the black. I'm stopping here.

**What I'd tell my son:**
"Listen, I haven't decided. I'll ask you, and someone at work, before I sign anything. What I understood: on 30,000 I put in 750 a month and the employer puts in 2,250, three times as much. That's money I wouldn't get otherwise. In five years the page says 45,000 from me and 135,000 from them. But the first picture was set to five years and showed a red '−64,761' in tax, and that scared me. Only further down, in a brown box, did I understand it's because taking it out before six years is expensive. The fund it shows is 'S&P500' with 'מדד', in other words shares. It's written plainly that 'המדינה לא ערבה' and it 'עולה ויורד'. That isn't a deposit. The 7% a year is the site's own guess, it says 'לא תחזית'. Fees go up to 2% a year. The companies are names I know, Harel, Altshuler, Meitav, Phoenix, and it's 'בפיקוח רשות שוק ההון'. I think it's worth joining for the employer's money and leaving it six years, but you tell me which track isn't shares."

**My account:** I read the top part, the boxes with my 30,000, the big bars and the lines under them. Then "מי מציע", "כסף נכנס ויוצא", "כמה זה עולה", the brown warning box and "סיכונים". I didn't read the small bar chart, the "מונחים" table or "שווה לדעת". I didn't reach the fifth screen. I got stuck on 5 years versus 6, on "S&P500", "מדד", "47% מס במקור", "הרווח הריאלי", "123 ממקור/מחושב" and "תשואה". The pale grey lines were hard to read. The black background tired me out. A menu bar sat across the middle of the text.
